body:
Owner-requested GitHub issue https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/500; parallel execution requested 2026-10-03.

## Problem
`corvint-tasks dispatch` and the supervisor script are long-running, but nothing restarts them after a crash or reboot, and the surrounding helper loops (health, steward) have the same gap. We found that a killed steward loop stayed dead indefinitely and a reboot would have stopped the whole program silently.

## Request
`corvint-tasks service install|status|uninstall --program P` generating and managing the OS unit (launchd LaunchAgent on macOS, systemd user unit on Linux) that keeps the supervisor/dispatcher alive, honors the existing stop file/drain, does not kill adopted workers on restart, and exposes liveness in `dispatch status`. A documented hook for registering extra helper commands to keep alive would cover site-specific loops.

Pitfall we hit: a launchd job that starts processes and exits kills them unless `AbandonProcessGroup` is set; the generated unit should handle this.

## Workaround in use
A LaunchAgent running a keepalive script every 2 minutes that restarts the supervisor, steward loop (also when its log is stale) and health loop.
